title: Animated transitions and mental models of spatial relationships
statement:
Animating transitions between application states helps users maintain a coherent mental model of spatial relationships within the interface.

Options:
- Continuous Context: Shared element morph (fits: gallery to detail, card expansion)
- Spatial Hierarchy: Smooth height expansion (fits: accordions, dropdown menus)
- Speed over Context: Instant cut (0ms) (fits: tab switching, expert tools)
appliesWhen: Applies to: navigation, accordions, page transitions. Audience: general.
